question: Why must drivers consider wheel spin rate when landing from a jump?
answer: Tyres grip when they turn at road speed. If wheels spin faster than the ground at touchdown, they slip before they bite, and at full throttle the engine over-revs. So drivers ease off the throttle mid-air, land on all four wheels, then accelerate.
move: Land with wheels turning at road speed and grip comes back at once.
